summary: Pump tripped to fault during a lightning storm; tank climbing with the pump stopped.
outcome: VFD showed an overcurrent fault. One reset held and the pump was back near rated flow within 10 minutes. Trucks were stood down before the first arrival.

summary: Pump fault with the tank already above the start setpoint; countdown just over two hours.
outcome: Mechanical seal had failed and the pump would not re-prime. Mechanic ETA was 3 h against a 2.2 h countdown, so two trucks took 300 bbl and the tank peaked at 88 %.

summary: Pump stopped on a tripped breaker; four hours to shutdown.
outcome: Breaker had tripped on a chewed cable in the junction box. Locked out, cable replaced, restarted after 90 minutes. The one truck trip already rolling was still used.

summary: Receive flow fell below pump flow over a day with pipeline pressure down about 30 psi.
outcome: Pinhole at a weld 400 m from the disposal end, found by walking from the pressure-drop end. Pump stopped, block valves closed, vac truck recovered 40 bbl; clamp fitted and back online next day.

summary: Receive ratio drifted to 0.91 over a day; discharge pressure unchanged.
outcome: Flange gasket weeping at the riser, contained inside the berm. Regulator notified; spill response not needed. Gasket replaced on day shift.

summary: Running flow ratio down to 0.86 and discharge about 12 psi low; receive ratio still 1.0.
outcome: Suction strainer half-blocked with paraffin. Cleaned and the ratio returned to 0.99. Impeller and wear-ring swap scheduled anyway for the next maintenance window.
